text:
ITEM 1 | Cherry tomatoes, glossy red-orange, whole and intact, slightly wrinkled skins, juicy-looking with slight sheen, about 12 pieces clustered in a rounded pile covering roughly 30% of the plate's lower-center area, each about 2.5 cm across, sitting on and beside the other items | 150
ITEM 2 | Breaded or crumbed cutlet-like piece, golden-brown to tan surface with rough crumb texture and darker browned edges, flat and roughly oval, about 9 cm by 6 cm and about 1.5 cm thick, placed on the left-center of the plate under the tomatoes | 130
ITEM 3 | Kimchi-style fermented cabbage, bright red-orange with pale white-green strands, moist and slightly glossy, limp leaf pieces piled in a mound about 6 cm by 5 cm and 2 cm high, sitting upper-right of the cutlet | 60
ITEM 4 | Sautéed greens with scallion-like pieces, dark green and pale yellow-white bits, slightly wilted and clumped, small mound about 5 cm by 4 cm and 1.5 cm high, sitting on top of the cutlet at upper-left | 25
ITEM 5 | Grilled eggplant or zucchini-type vegetable, dark grayish-green to brown skin with char marks and soft, slightly glossy flesh, a wedge about 7 cm by 4 cm and 1.5 cm high, sitting at the right edge of the plate beside the kimchi | 45
